You can view a location for 1 minute, anywhere: • I: Close by, within shouting distance • II: Within a few miles • III: Anywhere in Arden Eld You view the location as if an invisible observer, hearing and seeing everything. You cannot move your point of vision, and your body is immobile and vulnerable while taking this action. You can end it any time. You don’t have to be able to see the location you’re trying to view.

powers.name: Library Organ
powers.rulesText: 1/session - Get +1d on study and sense for the rest of the scene, but all other actions are at 0d. At chapter III, also increase all effect from study and sense.

powers.name: Argus
powers.rulesText: You get a knack for sensing: • I: Hidden objects, paths, tracks, or traps • II: Hidden people, monsters, or ambushes • III: Invisible or metaphysical objects or forces, such as the flow of magic

powers.name: Midnight Eyes
powers.rulesText: You can see in the dark, which could make your risk and effect better. Your study and sense actions get increased effect in darkness. At Chapter III or higher, you can see anything close by in good detail without the use of your eyes.

powers.name: Unhinge
powers.rulesText: When you push a desperate action, it also gains increased effect.

powers.name: Dark Clarity
powers.rulesText: 2/session - You may study the ambient emotional state of: • I: One person close by • II: One person or monster close by • III: All people or monsters close by You get an impression of how they are feeling and what the strongest emotion they are feeling is. Your next action including your target(s) that can act on this information gets +1 boon or increased effect.

powers.name: Possession
powers.rulesText: 2/session - Ask a presence inside you for advice. The GM will answer as the presence. Get +1d on the next action that follows that advice.

powers.name: Instinctive
powers.rulesText: 2/session - Describe a course of action to the GM you plan to take this session. You will receive an answer that is truthful, if unclear, that comes from a feeling. The GM can choose from the following options: Wheel (good/positive outcomes), Stone (bad/negative outcomes), and Chaos (a mix of good and bad outcomes).

powers.name: Geist
powers.rulesText: When you are able to touch someone skin to skin, even if you break contact, you can see through their eyes and experience their sensations and ambient emotional state, though you can do little but observe, and they are not aware of your presence. The effect can be accessed: The effect is canceled when you use this ability again, and while you’re concentrating on it, you cannot do anything yourself except sit in quiet focus, otherwise the effect breaks. A player character must be willing, and you may need a roll to be able to touch a hostile, unaware, or unwilling character.

powers.name: Terrible Truth
powers.rulesText: 1/session - Increase the effect of your next Study action to Superpowered

bonds.name: Mighty
bonds.summary: Use your prodigious physical or magical strength to destroy obstacles and help your friends. The Mighty revels in strength and power, and presents an unbreakable front to the enemy, but uses that power not to oppress and control, but to protect the vulnerable and stand against evil.
ideals: I addressed challenges with strength, leadership, or force
I expressed my heritage, background, or beliefs through my actions
I didn’t back down when faced with a challenge
bonds.secondWind: Regain all effort when you take injury or harm while protecting someone else
bonds.specialAbility: When an ally close to you suffers strain, you can take the strain for them. In addition, you can spend 1 Effort when you take any strain to reduce it by 1, to a minimum of 1.

kits.name: Adventurer’s kit
kits.itemsText: Lantern, pack, bedroll, rope, flint and tinder, journal, rations, cooking pot, knife, canvas tent

kits.name: Soldier’s Kit
kits.itemsText: Extra rations, whetstone, oil, two pairs of good boots, extra large pack, badge of rank, protection ward

kits.name: Mercenary’s Kit
kits.itemsText: Fortifying snack, iron flask, bounty ledger, backup weapon, foldable hand cart, heavy object for hitting someone with

kits.name: Brawler’s Kit
kits.itemsText: Healing ointment, copious bandages, splint, thick gauntlets or gloves, foldable stretcher, good luck charm

powers.name: True Grit
powers.rulesText: When you break, you remain in control of your character for the rest of the scene. If you would remain broken longer than that (you have 3 burdens for example) this effect ends at the end of the scene.

powers.name: Iron jaw
powers.rulesText: You can’t suffer critical strain (take 4 strain instead)

powers.name: Volcanic
powers.rulesText: 2/session - When someone or something harms an ally in your presence, you can trigger this ability to get +1d or increased effect (choose) on all actions against them for the rest of the scene

powers.name: Hammersoul
powers.rulesText: Your Smash actions have increased effect when you’re exhausted.

powers.name: Overpower
powers.rulesText: You can push by taking 2 strain instead of spending effort for Endure and Smash actions

powers.name: The Tower
powers.rulesText: While you’re at maximum strain, characters can aid you without spending effort. If you break, all characters that witness it recover 1 effort.

powers.name: Force of Will
powers.rulesText: 1/session - You can choose to automatically treat your next Command action roll against another character as a 6. The GM can decide a character is too strong willed for this to work on them, forcing you to roll normally, but if they do, regain 2 effort after that roll resolves. It always works on foes from a lower chapter than you.

powers.name: Half Light
powers.rulesText: When you gather information about violence or possible threats, you can use Endure, Smash, or Command

powers.name: The Wall
powers.rulesText: 1/session - This scene only, reduce all strain suffered by you or an ally of your choice by 1, to a minimum of 1

powers.name: Make Total Destroy
powers.rulesText: 1/session - Increase the effect of your next Smash action to superpowered

bonds.name: Wolf
bonds.summary: You are a tough exterior covered in scars. Your competency makes you strong, but you also can’t let anyone see where you’re vulnerable. The wolf stands strong alone, but can’t forget that they ultimately rely on the pack.
ideals: I addressed challenges with precision, coldness, or intimidation
I expressed my heritage, background, or beliefs through my actions
I let people see a glimpse of who I am beneath my mask
bonds.secondWind: Regain all effort when you fix someone else’s mistakes, or someone else fixes yours.
bonds.specialAbility: You are hardened. Your 4 clock burden gives you no penalties.

kits.name: Adventurer’s kit
kits.itemsText: Lantern, pack, bedroll, rope, flint and tinder, journal, rations, cooking pot, knife, canvas tent

kits.name: Solo’s Kit
kits.itemsText: Shadow cloak, collapsible weapon, spiked gloves and boots for climbing and combat, single use flash bomb, toxin vial - sleep toxin, slow acting poison, paralyzing toxin

kits.name: Survivor’s Kit
kits.itemsText: Pick-me-up - something to take the edge off, old bandages, lock picks, change of clothes, concealed weapon(s), faded memento, extensive memory of local street layout and back doors

kits.name: Wanderer’s Kit
kits.itemsText: Weatherproof cloak, hardy traveling outfit, extra rope, survival rations, hunting weapon, general knowledge of local fauna and flora - from good and bad experiences

powers.name: Clarity
powers.rulesText: If you break, regain all effort, and you can push your next action for free

powers.name: Scarcoat
powers.rulesText: +1 max strain per Burden you have

powers.name: Blood Scent
powers.rulesText: You get a knack for tracking or intimidating anyone or anything that’s wounded

powers.name: Go for a Walk
powers.rulesText: 1/session - When you separate from the group to do something alone, you can trigger this ability to get +1d and increased effect on your action. ‘Cut to black’ and roll the action ‘off-screen’, then cut back to when you return to the group, describing what happened.

powers.name: Cornered
powers.rulesText: When you are outnumbered in a tense or violent situation, leading team actions does not cost effort for you.

powers.name: Lurk
powers.rulesText: 1/session - When the GM describes a scene, you can choose to be there, hidden, appropriate to chapter. Don’t worry about how you got there.

powers.name: It’s Nothing
powers.rulesText: During Heal Burdens, heal 2 extra ticks on a burden of your choice if nobody helps you heal burdens. Heal 1 tick on two burdens if someone does help you heal, instead of just one burden. If you do so, you can’t help other people heal burdens.

powers.name: Crack Shell
powers.rulesText: When you’re exhausted, you can take aid actions without spending effort

powers.name: Bishop
powers.rulesText: When you set someone up, that person gets both +1d and increased effect on the set up roll.

powers.name: Wick
powers.rulesText: 1/session - Increase the power of your next Excel action to superpowered

bonds.name: Harlequin
bonds.summary: Trick, humiliate, and dance around the powerful. The Harlequin despises those who take themselves too seriously, and delights in slipping in and out of conversations, roles, and situations.
ideals: I addressed challenges with cunning, subterfuge, or deceit
I expressed my heritage, background, or beliefs through my actions
I talked or slipped my way out of a charged situation
bonds.secondWind: Regain all effort when your actions get you in trouble with someone or something powerful
bonds.specialAbility: When you’re exhausted, get +1d and increased effect on sneak

kits.name: Adventurer’s kit
kits.itemsText: Lantern, pack, bedroll, rope, flint and tinder, journal, rations, cooking pot, knife, canvas tent

kits.name: Entertainer’s kit
kits.itemsText: Instrument, fancy outfit, three free meals, tome of song lore, tickets to a show, extensive knowledge of local haunts, free entry and lodging for a single inn, tavern, or place to stay

kits.name: Rake’s kit
kits.itemsText: Hooded lantern, lock picks, paramour’s portrait, concealed weapon, loaded

kits.name: dice, gaming set, three extra outfits, disguise kit
kits.itemsText: - wigs, outfits, fake noses - etc - can be applied to others

kits.name: Trickster’s kit
kits.itemsText: Someone else’s pocket contents, ball bearings, official looking uniform, fire starter, very convenient key, large pouch of mysterious powder

powers.name: Mirrormask
powers.rulesText: You can always tell if someone is lying if you can see their face, though the nature of the lie is unclear. At chapter III, you only need to hear someone’s voice or read something they have written.

powers.name: Mercurio
powers.rulesText: You can change your appearance completely in only a few moments by spending 1 effort, including height, weight, gender presentation, etc. Anyone in view of you can witness you change. You must appear as Kin (a person), but you could be a different Kintype, and otherwise everything else is up to you. This effect lasts until you camp, or until you eat or drink something, and while active you get a knack for impersonating your new form, although if you’re trying to impersonate a specific person, people who know them will see through your disguise up close. At chapter III, this effect no longer costs effort if it's only used once a scene.

powers.name: Mockingbird
powers.rulesText: You get a knack for mimicking sounds or voices.

powers.name: Fast Friends
powers.rulesText: 2/session - You can choose to automatically treat your next charm action roll as a 6. If you do, its effects only last: • I: 1 minute • II: an hour • III a whole day After the duration expires, its target(s) realize they were manipulated.

powers.name: The Big Show
powers.rulesText: Critical hits on excel, charm, or sneak actions regain 2 effort for all party members who witness your feats

powers.name: Habitual Line Stepper
powers.rulesText: 2/session - You instantly disappear from sight and re-appear somewhere: • I: Nearby • II: Within two or three hundred paces • IIII: Within a mile You don’t have to see your destination, but you are shunted back to your starting point if it’s occupied or obstructed (like trying to hop into solid rock, for example).

powers.name: Quickfingers
powers.rulesText: 1/session - Name a number of objects nearby equal to the chapter number that you can see that could fit or carry in one or both hands. By the start of the next scene, you have possession of them. If you stole them, the person you stole it from will find out within the hour

powers.name: Ridi Pagliacci
powers.rulesText: You can invoke each of your burdens instead of spending 1 effort, once a session for each burden

powers.name: Exuent
powers.rulesText: When you lead an action to flee or escape trouble, don’t spend effort.

powers.name: Step of the Smiling Few
powers.rulesText: 1/session - Increase the power of your next Sneak action to superpowered

bonds.name: Highborn
bonds.summary: You were born into a sheltered existence, both protected and constrained by wealth, walls, or rules, a curse as much as it is a blessing. You have privileges, power, and knowledge that others envy, but have so much else to learn about the world.
ideals: I addressed challenges with poise, passion, or social status
I challenged or acted against my heritage, background, or standing beliefs with my actions
I learned something new about my companions
bonds.secondWind: You may regain all effort when someone else relieves all effort
bonds.specialAbility: When you’re exhausted, characters that aid you spend no effort

kits.name: You do not have an adventurer’s kit
kits.itemsText: , but can pick a combo of two basic kits instead, or five

kits.name: Noble’s kit
kits.itemsText: Two changes of fancy clothes, dueling weapon, personal reference, traveling trunk, expensive jewelry, general knowledge of city politics, noble pedigree or family reputation

kits.name: Academic kit
kits.itemsText: Thick-bound almanac, late night snacks, massive sheathes of rambling but

kits.name: extensive notes, hobby journal, sample kit
kits.itemsText: , extra large pack, expensive arkentech contraption - compass, scope, etc - top of the line but breakable and can only be used once

kits.name: Cloister kit
kits.itemsText: Simple ritual gear - candles, bowl, talismans, protective ward, traveling staff or walking stick, good hat, badge of a scholarly, wright, or religious order - proving membership, old arkentech relic of unknown use

powers.name: Rarefied
powers.rulesText: You have a knack for actions involving people considered highborn or high class. However, if you use this knack, all actions involving people considered low class or lowborn are 0d at best until the end of the session.

powers.name: Private Tutor
powers.rulesText: You've had specialized training. Choose any action. You can re-roll any ‘1’s you roll as part of that action, keeping the new result. However, choose one other action that you neglected - you must re-roll any ‘6’s as part of this action, keeping the new result.

powers.name: Silver Spoon
powers.rulesText: You can never be accused of trespassing except by someone considered high rank or high class (a manager, a noble, a military officer, etc), appropriate to chapter. This effect does not extend to anyone else with you, but get +1d on rolls to cover for them. At chapter II, you can cover for one extra person without question, and at chapter III you can cover for anyone you like within reason.

powers.name: Trust the Fund
powers.rulesText: You always have enough in your pockets to sway someone when you try to gain access, assets, or information. If you do, gain +1d or increased effect, but it’s incredibly obvious that you’re bribing them.

powers.name: Special reserve
powers.rulesText: Get +1d or increased effect when you gather information or recall info on something rare, expensive, or hard to find.

powers.name: Ivory Tower
powers.rulesText: 2/session - When the GM describes a location, monster, person, or historical event, you can ask the GM for an additional detail only an expert would know and get a truthful answer. Get +1d the next time you act on the answer.

powers.name: Honor Student
powers.rulesText: If you forgo healing burdens, you can tick an extra segment on an ambition. If you take one other character along with you to observe, they can also tick a segment on their own ambitions.

powers.name: Passionate
powers.rulesText: You always have a secret passion ambition you can work on, something you’ve wanted to try but never been able to. It’s a 12 segment ambition clock that gives 3 xp for completing it, and can be worked on for free each interlude. If you complete your passion, you can pursue a new one.

powers.name: Unflappable
powers.rulesText: Leading actions to Command or Charm a large group costs no effort for you

powers.name: Perfect Grace
powers.rulesText: 1/session. Increase the effect of your next Charm action to superpowered.

bonds.name: Mender
bonds.summary: You gather your group with cheer and good attitude. You use your power to fix, heal, and mend. You can be quiet, but when you’re loud, people listen.
ideals: I addressed challenges with diplomacy, positivity, or empathy
I expressed my heritage, background, or beliefs through my actions
I learned how someone or something was broken.
bonds.secondWind: You only regain effort from bond powers, camping, or interludes.
bonds.specialAbility: You can allow someone else to regain 1 effort by spending 1 effort.

kits.name: Adventurer’s kit
kits.itemsText: Lantern, pack, bedroll, rope, flint and tinder, journal, rations, cooking pot, knife, canvas tent

kits.name: Mending Kit
kits.itemsText: Healing ointment, light reading, snacks, bandages, blanket, splint, salve, blight remedies, apron, clean gloves, holy icon, copious sweets

kits.name: Hearth Kit
kits.itemsText: Great cooking pot, oversized coat, bright lantern, extra ingredients, seasoning, firewood, spacious tent, large pack, arkentech hot plate and igniter that can start a fire anywhere, even underwater

kits.name: Work Kit
kits.itemsText: Goggles, sandwich, vials for storage, weak acid, metal augur, heavy toolbox - pliers, spanners, tools, wire, etc, repurposed arkentech doodad - single use

powers.name: Push through
powers.rulesText: You can take 1 strain instead of spending effort to take aid actions, which cannot be reduced or ignored.

powers.name: Divine Luck
powers.rulesText: When you take strain as a consequence, roll a 1d6 fortune roll. On 6, reduce the strain suffered to 0 (even critical strain).

powers.name: Illuminate
powers.rulesText: Your actions have +1 boon or increased effect (choose) with or against characters or creatures that trust you.

powers.name: Untangle
powers.rulesText: When you help someone else lift burdens, you increase their segments healed by +1, and heal 1 segment yourself

powers.name: Pangloss
powers.rulesText: When you fail a desperate action, your next action can be pushed without spending effort.

powers.name: A Better Way
powers.rulesText: When you study to understand how something or someone is hurt or broken, or tinker to fix something, get +1d or increased effect. This ability works without effect loss on: • I: One person or a small object • II: A whole group of people or a large object • III: A whole town, or a massive object such as a train, huge machine, etc

powers.name: Mender
powers.rulesText: 2/session - You can charm or tinker to heal someone’s strain. Check the final result: • 0-3 - Characters can spend 1 effort to heal 1 strain • 4-5 - Character heals 1 strain • 6 - Character heals 2 strain • 6,6 - Character heals 4 strain

powers.name: Encourage
powers.rulesText: 2/session - Spend a use of this ability to use aid without spending effort or exposing yourself to consequences

powers.name: Iron Cutting
powers.rulesText: At the end of each interlude, you can tick 2 segments total, split between any ambition, project clock, or ritual clock of your choice, even those belonging to another character.

powers.name: Heart Forge
powers.rulesText: 1/session - Increase the effect of your next Tinker action to superpowered

bonds.name: Brave
bonds.summary: Use your courage, luck, and wits to smash head on into problems. The Brave is always at the front line, hurling themselves at problems, and hoping their allies will pick up the pieces. They’re at their best when relying on fate, teamwork, and the power of perseverance.
ideals: I addressed challenges with perseverance, friendship, and courage
I expressed my heritage, background, or beliefs through my actions
I used my heart rather than my head to solve a problem
bonds.secondWind: Regain all effort when you charge forth without a plan
bonds.specialAbility: When you lead a team action, get +1d on the action or increased effect

kits.name: Adventurer’s kit
kits.itemsText: Lantern, pack, bedroll, rope, flint and tinder, journal, rations, cooking pot, knife, canvas tent

kits.name: Brave Kit
kits.itemsText: Signature outfit, 3 arkentech light gems, map to a mysterious place, northstone - always tells north and time of day, even underground, trinket from home, arkentech power gauntlet - single use,

kits.name: Explorer kit
kits.itemsText: Waterproof cloak, extendable walking pole - 3 to 10 ft , compass, flask, three empty bottles, chalk, 6 depth stones - toss to check depth of pits, abyss stone - glows when monsters are nearby

kits.name: Inherited Kit
kits.itemsText: Hexagonal key, oddly fitting clothing, antique armor piece, broken arkenrelic, heirloom weapon, memories of a prophecy

powers.name: Strike the road
powers.rulesText: The first team action you lead in a session costs you 0 effort

powers.name: Crush Limiter
powers.rulesText: 1/session, you can give your next action superpowered effect, but take a burden at the end of the scene.

powers.name: Luck as a Constant
powers.rulesText: When you critical hit, regain all effort, heal all strain, and mark 1 xp

powers.name: All in
powers.rulesText: Using Aid to help a character taking a desperate action costs 0 effort for you

powers.name: Joyluck Wind Thrower
powers.rulesText: When you take a desperate action, you can take +1d on the action. If you do, treat any die less than a 6 as a 1.

powers.name: The Sun
powers.rulesText: 1/session - Gain increased effect on all actions for the rest of the scene

powers.name: Coordinate
powers.rulesText: Aiding you on team actions costs 0 effort

powers.name: Heart of Hearts
powers.rulesText: 1/session - You can flash back to a scene from your past or hometown and describe how your memory of that time inspires you in the current moment. You can treat your next roll as though you rolled a critical hit (6,6). You can only use this ability three times ever, and when you expend its third use, replace this power with another one.

powers.name: Team Player
powers.rulesText: When any ally sets you up, you have increased effect on the roll

powers.name: Brave Destiny
powers.rulesText: 1/session. Increase the effect of the next team action you take to superpowered.

bonds.name: Broker
bonds.summary: Use your superior skills, class, intellect, or delicate touch to handle situations with elegance. You’ve been there before, and you have a plan for everything under the sun. Some may call you stuck up, but they don’t see how the strings you pull save their sorry hides again and again.
ideals: I addressed challenges with manipulation, influence, or planning
I expressed my heritage, background, or beliefs through my actions
Despite my best efforts, we went wildly off plan
bonds.secondWind: You can regain all effort when another team mate becomes exhausted or breaks.
bonds.specialAbility: When you become exhausted or break, all team mates regain 1 effort

kits.name: Adventurer’s kit
kits.itemsText: Lantern, pack, bedroll, rope, flint and tinder, journal, rations, cooking pot, knife, canvas tent

kits.name: Shady Kit
kits.itemsText: False identity papers, tilted hat, quick disguise, coat with six hidden pockets, lock picks, forgery tools, convenient bribe, arkentech skeleton key - opens or activates most arkentech devices

kits.name: Socialite’s Kit
kits.itemsText: Two fancy outfits, one very fancy outfit, one inconspicuous outfit, one servant’s outfit, really nice pair of shoes, jewelry, tailoring supplies, address of anyone in a city or town, single invite to any party

kits.name: Boss’s Kit
kits.itemsText: Ledger, gambling kit, crowbar, flask of something strong - coffee, tea, or alcohol, guild membership badge, key to a warehouse, scuffed pair of arkentech radios - not effective over distance

powers.name: Contingency
powers.rulesText: 2/session. You can use this power to ‘flash back’ in time to tell the GM how you prepared for a situation. You can use this ability before or after any action roll to do one of the following: Set up a character for the next action (even yourself), resist consequences of something that just happened by taking strain, even for another character, increase effect or lower risk. To do so, however, you need to be able to tell the GM how you prepared and also make fortune roll using one of your actions to see how well your preparation went. On a 4+ gain the expected effect, on a 6 choose an extra effect, and on a 1-3 you had to abandon the plan (this ability has no effect this scene and regain 1 use).

powers.name: Swoon
powers.rulesText: 1/session. When you would take consequences as a result of your actions, you have may another willing character nearby take the consequences instead of you after you learn what they are. If they do, they take 1 xp.

powers.name: Immaculate
powers.rulesText: Get a knack for situations where being dressed appropriately would help you (disguises, uniforms, outfits, formalwear, etc), appropriate to chapter.

powers.name: Beg, Borrow, or Steal
powers.rulesText: When you need the right tool for the job (a disguise, a tool, a weapon, a portable boat, a ladder) you can choose to have it right now. The tool’s power, type, and rarity depends on chapter, and it lasts until the end of the session, or until you use this ability again. Gain +1d on actions using the tool, but the GM chooses one: • It was stolen from someone, who will track you down by next interlude • It’s poor quality and breaks after the scene is over • It gets you into trouble after the scene is over (it attracts attention, there’s an unwanted side effect, it leads you somewhere you weren’t expecting to go)

powers.name: Fruitful
powers.rulesText: You have a contact or family member in every populated location. Define this person with the GM and pick one (choose carefully): not in trouble with the law, reliable, won’t need a favor. Roll +1d on actions where your contact could help you.

powers.name: Faust
powers.rulesText: 1/session. The next time you roll, treat all 1s as 6s. The next time you roll after that, treat all 6s as 1s.

powers.name: Make it work
powers.rulesText: 1/session. You may use your highest rated action for any single action with normal effectiveness (charming a door to open for example). Explain to the GM how you’re doing this. At chapter III, you don’t need to explain.

powers.name: Coordinator
powers.rulesText: You get 2 xp for pursuing a group ambition instead of 1, and gain +1d when working on a group ambition.

powers.name: Ladder Climber
powers.rulesText: You can pursue ambitions twice during an interlude, but only if you pursue different ambitions.

powers.name: Golden Hand
powers.rulesText: 1/session. Increase the effect of your next Command action to superpowered.

bonds.name: Elder
bonds.summary: You’ve been around a long time - maybe too long. You’ve seen a lot of what Arden Eld has to offer - the good and the bad. The adventuring life, with its threats, its challenges, and it’s wandering lifestyle, are something you would perhaps want put behind you, but you have a little more work to do before you can put your gear away for good. There are people out there who need you.
ideals: I addressed challenges with patience, wisdom, or experience
I expressed my heritage, background, or beliefs through my actions
I defused a potentially violent situation
bonds.secondWind: You can regain all effort when you manage to avoid confrontation or violence through your actions.
bonds.specialAbility: At the start of a session, choose another character to watch over. The first time in the session that character would take a burden, you can intervene and choose to take that burden instead if you have one free. If you do, regain all effort and clear all strain, and mark +1 xp.

kits.name: Weathered adventurer’s kit
kits.itemsText: Rusted lantern, well-worn pack, flat bedroll, three loops of sturdy rope, flint and tinder, arkentech firestarter, thick journal, extra rations, sturdy cooking pot, nicked utility knife, sleeping bag

kits.name: Veteran’s kit
kits.itemsText: Broken famous weapon, old

kits.name: badge of rank, weapon care kit
kits.itemsText: , painful memento, the most solid boots in the world, thick and warm cloak, good knowledge of wound care

kits.name: Hermit’s kit
kits.itemsText: Herbal medicine, icon of a magic or religious order, heavy and sturdy walking stave, light pack, excellent hat, good knowledge of local foraging - food, medicine, poisonous plants, etc

kits.name: Nostalgic kit
kits.itemsText: Memories of the local area from a long time ago, a useful story you heard once, a safe place you know about nearby, an excellent sense of direction

powers.name: Parable
powers.rulesText: Twice a session, you can ask the GM about any path of action ahead of you. The GM will answer as truthfully as possible with the phrase ‘This is the path of ____”, with the blank part being an animal, plant, or natural element (fire/water/earth/wind) that the GM feels best fits the situation. Gain +1d when next acting on the answer.

powers.name: Pacifist
powers.rulesText: If you leave a scene of violence without harming anyone, heal 1 strain and regain 1 effort.

powers.name: Long Memory
powers.rulesText: Gain +1d on rolls to gather information about any event that happened more than ten years ago. At chapter III, if it happened in your lifetime, you can also tell the GM you remember it clearly or were actually there and can’t fail the roll (treat a 1-3 as a 4+).

powers.name: Been Around
powers.rulesText: Unless they draw a weapon, nobody younger than you can harm, restrain, or touch you in any way unless you let them. This effect ignores chapter.

powers.name: Spinner of Tales
powers.rulesText: You get a 12 segment ambition clock that you can work on for free each interlude, to tell a story from your past. When the clock is complete, a character of your choice that listened to you can improve an action by 1. A character can only gain this benefit once.

powers.name: Pillar of Rock
powers.rulesText: Until you use violence or coerce someone or something in a session, reduce all strain taken from other people by 1, to a minimum of 1.

powers.name: Saltbelly
powers.rulesText: Gain +1d for the rest of the session against anyone that shares a meal, shares a drink, or plays a game of skill against you.

powers.name: Mentor
powers.rulesText: You can forgo working on your own ambitions to come along and help someone else with theirs. If you do, they tick 1 more segment and gain +1d.

powers.name: Reputation
powers.rulesText: When you enter a populated area you haven’t visited before, you can decide that people there have heard of you. This gives you +1d to interact with them socially for the rest of the session, but anyone who wants to find or track you can find you easily. This works on:

powers.name: The Mountain
powers.rulesText: 1/session. Increase the effect of your next Endure action to superpowered.

bonds.name: Outsider
bonds.summary: You’re not from around here. You’re a little strange or unique in appearance, customs, or culture, and it can make people cautious or uneasy, but also curious. You may have come from a chronicler monastery, or a hermit village at the edge of the world, or you might literally be a fish out of water, from a town on the sea floor. Your perspective on things can be refreshing and you have powerful talents you can bring to bear.
ideals: I addressed challenges with my unique perspective, talents, or culture
I expressed heritage, background, or beliefs through my actions
I made a new friend, or deepened an existing friendship.
bonds.secondWind: Regain all effort when you spend a scene trying not to use your unique talents or abilities
bonds.specialAbility: You gain +1d to set characters up.

kits.name: You only have the outsider’s kit
kits.itemsText: . However, you can take four pieces of loose gear with you on an expedition, at the end of an interlude can take any other piece of gear from any other bond used by player character in your party and add it to your loose gear list.

kits.name: Outsider’s kit
kits.itemsText: Strangely shaped lantern, pack, bedroll, 5 fire stones - hot!, food from home, foreign clothes, local clothes, icon from a distant land, unique weapon or tool, script in a foreign language

powers.name: Xenoclash
powers.rulesText: Choose two actions. Once a session, you can push each of these actions without spending effort. Describe the unique talents or abilities that allow you to do this.

powers.name: Gaia Compass
powers.rulesText: You have a knack for navigation. You always know the distance and direction of the nearest (I) village (II) town (III) settlement of any kind. You can sense dungeons within a few miles, and get a bad feeling when one is about to surface.

powers.name: Open Up
powers.rulesText: You can spend time with one other character during an interlude trying to understand each other. If you do, you can each aid each other once without spending effort during the next expedition.

powers.name: Bloom
powers.rulesText: Any character can set out a unique ambition clock once with 4 segments to try and learn a little of your language and customs. If they finish the clock, they gain 1 xp and they can understand your language, allowing you to communicate with them privately. You can decide whether an NPC speaks your language or not.

powers.name: Earth Glide
powers.rulesText: You have an unusual way of moving due to skills, magical talent, or anatomy. You gain a knack for movement through certain terrain and don’t suffer reduced effect moving through it. Pick one per chapter: Forests, Oceans, Mountains, Snow, Swamps, Deserts.

powers.name: Tour Guide
powers.rulesText: When a character works on ambitions or a project, they can bring you along. Roll a 1d6 fortune roll. On a 1, despite your best efforts you don’t help, giving -1d on the roll. On a 2-5, your unique insights help, giving +1d on the roll. On a 6, you offer a perspective that both gives +1d and allows them to tick 1 more segment.

powers.name: Earth Speech
powers.rulesText: You can speak and understand something unusual, and have normal effect while doing so. Your conversation partners might not speak language, or be particularly eloquent. Whether they are actually talking back or not is up to the tone of your game. Pick one per chapter: Animals, Plants, Rocks, Weapons, Tools, Vehicles

powers.name: Centered
powers.rulesText: 1/session. You have a unique cuisine, or a unique eating or drinking stricture or habit. When you share it with someone or explain it to them, they gain +1d to set you up for the rest of the session, and you get +1d on the next roll involving them.

powers.name: Resourceful
powers.rulesText: You can bring one more piece of loose gear with you on an expedition.

powers.name: The Wave
powers.rulesText: 1/session. Increase the effect of your next sense action to superpowered.

bonds.name: Dreamer
bonds.summary: You are optimistic, perhaps to a fault. You might be new the to the adventuring life, young, or a little green around the ears - or perhaps you are simply too wise to be cynical. Not everything goes right when you try it, but try it you must.
ideals: I addressed challenges with creativity, cheer, or trust in my allies
I expressed my heritage, background, or beliefs through my actions
I failed miserably
bonds.secondWind: You can regain all effort when someone helps you out of a bad situation. Your rescuer can also recover 1 effort.
bonds.specialAbility: Characters that successfully aid you or set you up can recover 1 effort, but no more than once a session.

kits.name: Adventurer’s kit
kits.itemsText: Lantern, pack, bedroll, rope, flint and tinder, journal, rations, cooking pot, knife, canvas tent

kits.name: Improvised Kit
kits.itemsText: Fistful of sand, convenient rock, makeshift key, homemade tool, pocket snacks, slingshot

kits.name: Unlucky Kit
kits.itemsText: A sudden fall, an untied knot, a slip, a broken pot or cup, a flying object

kits.name: Lucky Kit
kits.itemsText: A single useful clue, a sudden change in lighting, a shift in the weather, a convenient noise, a useful crack in a wall or door

powers.name: Improvise
powers.rulesText: 2/session. You can push a smash roll for free if you can somehow use something that’s not a weapon from your environment. This could also increase or decrease effect, depending on the item. You can use something:

powers.name: Punching Bag
powers.rulesText: If you take strain from anything, everyone else gets increased effect against that thing for the rest of the scene.

powers.name: Best efforts
powers.rulesText: If you fail a set-up roll, you can take 1 strain to re-roll it, taking the second result. You can do this any number of times.

powers.name: Bright Eyed
powers.rulesText: At the start of each session, you may choose another character to look up to. You can aid that character without spending effort this session (you still share in any consequences), but aiding other characters costs 2 effort.

powers.name: Follow the Leader
powers.rulesText: 1/session. Make an action roll using any character’s action rating for that action. Describe how that character taught or inspired you.

powers.name: Lost cat
powers.rulesText: If you invoked your burdens to get into trouble during a session, you can choose a character that came to your aid and let them mark 1 xp at the end of a session.

powers.name: Rash
powers.rulesText: 1/session. Once a session, if you boast about your success on a roll before you roll, you can force yourself to roll at a max of 0d, but you regain 1 effort after the roll. If you actually succeed (4+), everyone else can regain 1 effort as well.

powers.name: Underdog
powers.rulesText: When you become exhausted, your next action gains +1d and increased effect.

powers.name: Heart Held Dream
powers.rulesText: You gain +1d to work on any ambition clock that’s 10 segments or longer. When you finish such a clock, you can lift a burden, or allow an ally to lift a burden.

powers.name: The Lobster
powers.rulesText: If you break, your next action can be made normally, even while broken, and gains superpowered effect.
